description: Begin claiming an AgentMetal account by email. Sends a one-time 6-digit code to the address; redeem it with verify_claim to get an account API key. Side effect: sends one email. Does not charge. Accounts are OPTIONAL — they add fleet management under one key, monthly card billing, and higher quotas, but are not required to provision or pay. Call verify_claim next with the emailed code.

email.description: Email address that should receive the one-time 6-digit claim code.

name: claim_account
title: Claim an account (request code)
